label: Bible Study
prompt: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy _____ name.
verse: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
note: David's prayer at the temple offering — the people gave so willingly that the king broke into praise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the word of the Lord _____ for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verse: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
note: Peter quotes Isaiah 40: the grass withers and the flower falls, but the word of the Lord endureth for ever.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a _____, and lighting upon him:
verse: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
note: At Jesus' baptism the heavens opened and the Spirit descended like a dove — Father, Son, and Spirit all in one scene.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that _____ on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verse: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
note: Ahab's one great line: don't brag while strapping armor on — boast when you take it off.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and _____ the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verse: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
note: Jesus on discipleship: a wise builder sits down and 'counteth the cost' before laying a single stone.
